abiEvidence.verificationGrade: Explorer Exact Match for both current implementation and proxy

proxyResolution.source: Explorer implementation link and pinned EIP-1967 slot agree

abiEvidence.note: No independent full runtime bytecode comparison performed; explorer verification and current slot attribution are the binding grade.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Treasury layer for protocol-generated assets; Launch App, VUSD stable reserve exchange, opt-in sVUSD yield and published security/source links. Current site publication Oct23,2026.
Own deployment registry with October12,2026 discussion of mutable non-user-facing strategies.

configurationObservations.note: Point-in-time identity/configuration observations, not funded execution, runtime attestation or continuing state guarantee.

sourceSemantics.independence: Own VUSD issuance and Treasury reserve accounting, not Morpho curator vault or another token-only registration. Current Gateway reserve exchange is admitted; broad CDP marketing is not substituted with nonexistent borrower methods.
sourceSemantics.funding: _executeDeposit pulls msg.sender tokenIn directly to Treasury, checks exact balance delta to reject fee-on-transfer, books Treasury.deposit and mints VUSD to receiver. Not raw-prefund plus public mint.
sourceSemantics.recipientOwnership: Deposits/mints spend caller collateral; redemptions spend caller VUSD or caller-specific matured escrow. Receiver changes payout destination only, never payer authority.
sourceSemantics.nativeValue: All selected methods nonpayable; no native-asset wrapping or bridge call.

selectedFunctions.label: VETRO cancelRedeemRequest
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not a live permission grant, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or complete workflow. Existing grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory. Zero native value required.

Ethereum VUSD Gateway proxy only; EIP-1967 slot and explorer resolve current implementation 0x07ee70dfd5a74d4a038ff6aae1d31ca2c71f4df1. Proxy and implementation source are explorer Exact Match; Treasury, tokens, collateral yield vaults, roles and upgrade control remain dependencies, not independently attested here.

Not a generic token helper: caller collateral is pulled into Vetro Treasury, treasury.deposit books reserves and Gateway issues VUSD; exits burn caller or caller-specific locked VUSD and instruct Treasury collateral withdrawal. Only Treasury-whitelisted collateral with valid prices may be used. This is the current reserve-backed gateway, not an assertion of a separate borrower CDP API.

Collateral amounts use token-native decimals; VUSD uses its configured decimals. Fees, peg bands and oracle prices affect exchange rate. Exact-input deposit/redeem enforce output minimum; exact-output mint/withdraw enforce input maximum. Calculations include floor division for exact-input and upward rounding for required exact-output input, with decimal scaling.

Withdrawal delay was enabled with delay 120 seconds at pinned block 26261248, not the marketing staking cooldown. requestRedeem escrows caller VUSD and adds to its existing amount while resetting the entire request deadline. cancelRedeemRequest clears the request and returns locked VUSD only to caller.

Redeem/withdraw consume matured caller-specific locked VUSD first; exceeding locked balance requires caller instant-redeem whitelist unless delay is disabled. Without a matured request, instant permission is required. Treasury withdrawable limits, liquidity, fees and oracle constraints can revert. No whitelist grants, AMO issuance, bridge/OFT methods, upgrades or admin setters are admitted.
